bagPolicy.summary: Rhizome DC hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Street parking is usually easy to find near Rhizome DC. In the evening, you can also use the spots on the north side of the house marked private parking only. The Takoma Metro station on the Red Line is a few blocks away.
parking.quote: There is usually ample parking on the street. If it is evening hours, you can park in the spots on the north side of the house that say "private parking only".

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Rhizome DC. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: You're welcome to bring your own food and drink to Rhizome DC, and you can use the fridge. Take your carryout leftovers with you when you go.
concessions.quote: Yes. You can use our fridge. Take your carryout leftovers with you though!

accessibility.summary: A ramp leads up to the back door, and performances almost always happen on the first floor. The only bathroom is upstairs, and exhibitions are usually upstairs too. Contact Rhizome DC ahead of time if you need help.
accessibility.quote: There is a ramp leading up to the backdoor. The only bathroom is upstairs. Performances almost always happen on the first floor.

reEntry.summary: Rhizome DC hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Rhizome DC events are all ages in almost all cases.

gates.summary: Door times vary by event and are listed with each event on the Rhizome DC homepage. Some events take place in the backyard, so check the listing for where to go.
gates.quote: doors at 7, movie at 7:30 * In the backyard * Free / donations
